transcript.note: Round 4, criterion 4 (tighten what should be tight). Rounds 1-3 spread the map out to give me room to get the bearings right, which left 18 of 77 columns and 23 of 86 rows carrying nothing at all - empty tracks are exactly the 'long empty stretch' the criterion says to compress, and they are pure waste rather than spacing that means something. I closed every unused column and row and left every point's position relative to its neighbours alone. That is order-preserving on both axes by construction, so criterion 3 is untouched (no point crossed another in east-west or north-south order), and any segment that was horizontal or vertical stays horizontal or vertical, so hv is unchanged at 70. I re-derived the winding order at all 65 degree-3+ points afterwards because closing tracks does change the angles between neighbours even though it does not change their order - it came back clean. Result: grid 77x86 -> 59x63 (a third of the cells gone), hv 70/161 held, hvd actually improved 76 -> 80 because closing tracks brought several near-diagonals onto exact 45 degrees, and cross / vtxOn / collide are still 0.
